title: Vera proposes support ticket status and priority to the team, each behind a confirm card

source.ref: Owner ask 2026-11-03 16:38Z (Vera makes the changes the user directs, always confirming before it writes), 2026-11-04 06:13Z (approved to get this done) and 13:26Z (Admin Assistant scope: answers plus confirmed changes through the existing admin actions); Vera assistants plan /mnt/project-files/vera-assistants-2026-11-03/REPORT.md, phase V4.

detail:
LIVE-2190 gave a staff caller live answers. Now Vera can also propose admin changes through the existing admin actions, starting with support ticket triage: a ticket's status (open, in progress, waiting, resolved, closed) or priority (low, normal, high, urgent), on a confirm card with plain words. The list is closed (lib/ai/vera/admin-changes.ts); moderation verdicts, suspensions, money and anything that cannot be undone stay on the admin pages. The set_ticket tool is an operator tool the agent offers only with the staff lookup, the chokepoint refuses a change off the list, and a tap finds the ticket only for a staff session, then goes through the support console's own setTicketFields, which re-checks the caller.

Shipped: admin-changes.ts, the set_ticket tool, the chokepoint branch, the confirm path in app/onboarding/vera-actions.ts, tests and probe.
